text: Good evening. I'm writing about my grandson, who is 9 and staying with us this week while his parents are abroad. He came in from the garden this afternoon saying he felt rotten, and his temperature this evening is 38.3. When I got him ready for his bath I noticed some marks on his legs and a few on his tummy. They're small, darkish red, a bit like someone has flicked a pen at him. I may be overthinking it, but I remembered reading somewhere that you should press a glass against them. I did that a couple of times with a tumbler from the kitchen, and as far as I can tell they don't go away. You can still see them clearly through the glass. I tried in good light as well in case my eyes were playing tricks. His neck seems fine, I think. I asked him to look down at his toes and he did it without any fuss. My wife says I should ring, but I thought I'd message first in case it's nothing. He's in bed now and I'll sit with him until I hear from you.
